payload.title: Validating PReSto2k
payload.description: This notebook validates the PReSto2k reconstructions by comparing them against the LMRv2.1 baseline and instrumental datasets. It involves loading reconstructions, plotting GMST, computing differences, and validating against instrumental datasets.

steps.description: Load necessary libraries and set up the environment for the analysis.
steps.title: Setup and Imports

steps.description: Load the PReSto2k reconstructions with different seasonality approaches and the LMRv2.1 dataset.
steps.title: Load Reconstructions

steps.description: Plot the Global Mean Surface Temperature (GMST) ensembles for all reconstructions to identify differences.
steps.title: Plot GMST Ensembles

steps.description: Compute the ensemble means and plot the differences between reconstructions.
steps.title: Compute and Plot Differences

steps.description: Use the plume framework with the pens package to compare reconstructions.
steps.title: Pens Framework

steps.description: Validate PReSto2k reconstructions against instrumental datasets like GISTEMP, HADCRUT5, and BEST.
steps.title: Instrumental Validation

steps.description: Validate reconstructions using the GISTEMP dataset.
steps.title: GISTEMP Validation

steps.description: Validate reconstructions using the HADCRUT5 dataset.
steps.title: HADCRUT5 Validation

steps.description: Validate reconstructions using the Berkeley Earth Surface Temperature (BEST) dataset.
steps.title: BEST Validation

steps.description: Combine all instrumental datasets to calculate a consensus time series and compare it with reconstructions.
steps.title: Consensus Analysis

steps.description: Load proxy databases for overlay and further analysis.
steps.title: Load Proxy Database
